integrity: Analytic proof supported by a portable exact-rational checker; correctness/originality/value are self-reviewed only; no independent audit or historical-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for symmetric migration fractions in [0,1/2] alternating over two years, positive constant habitat multipliers, and density-independent linear reproduction then mixing; not a nonlinear long-term persistence result. Qualitative variability penalties are known. Full Watson et al. (2012) technical content was inaccessible, so historical priority is provisional.
title: A sharp fluctuation penalty and invasion threshold for two-patch periodic dispersal
